The Discourse on All Directions:
Do all the Buddhas abide in all directions?
Yes, they do.
Is it to be said that “the Buddha stands in the eastern direction”?
No, indeed it should not be so said … [and so on] … Is it to be said that “the Buddha stands in the eastern direction”?
“Yes. “What is the name of that Blessed One? What is his caste? What is his clan? What are the names of that Blessed One’s mother and father?
What is the name of that Blessed One’s pair of chief disciples? What is the name of that Blessed One’s attendant? What kind of robe does he wear?”
"What kind of bowl does he carry? In which village, town, city, kingdom, or province [does he dwell]?
